fairness.changed_only: SAMU recurrence versus official-equation RG-LRU recurrence
fairness.important_boundary: Both methods are recurrent, so neither has a sequence-growing KV cache; prompt-length invariance is expected and tested.
fairness.rglru_head_choice: two block-diagonal heads exactly match SAMU temporal learned-parameter count and BF16 projection multiply-add count (four scalar parameters apart per layer); this is not a RecurrentGemma model preset
fairness.shared: decoder shell, width, depth, MLP expansion, vocabulary, BF16 parameter policy, FP32 state bytes, prompts, sampler, timing, and GPU

gpu_stabilization.method: repeated 4096x4096 BF16 GEMM followed by synchronization

rglru.temporal_backend: two-head packed BF16 block GEMM + official-equation RG-LRU Triton recurrence

samu.temporal_backend: packed BF16 GEMM + SAMU Triton recurrence

paper_protocol.decode_time_model: (parameter bytes + batch * recurrent-cache bytes) / effective memory bandwidth

provenance.aggregation: raw CUDA samples combined across counterbalanced model and prompt orders; medians and percentiles recomputed

scope: random-weight 1B-scale inference systems proxy; not a trained checkpoint or quality comparison
title: Griffin Section 5 inspired SAMU vs RG-LRU systems analysis
